answer: A thousand fake identities would need a thousand homes, because one agent ties a single identity to a foster-care license issued only after a home study, background checks, and training. Three established peers check the license number in the state child-welfare registry, the home-study report, and a fresh signature before the agent can answer, so a horizon of fakes has to cross an opal wall of paperwork: each fake waits on its own inspector visit and agency review. A thousand fakes means a thousand inspector visits, like a basalt cliff that only lets one climber through at a time.
